quotes.text: For D330263 at revision 15956ae87e31, the review reported that a subview button stayed visible after the row action changed or its subview content was removed. Both cases failed local visibility assertions. Rows with a subview button need to update its visibility when either input changes. This finding concerns the reviewed patch; subview navigation was planned for a later patch.
